verdict.rationale: Crossplane offers Composition Revisions for managing changes to Compositions. Its declarative YAML can be committed to source control and driven through GitOps workflows. The CLI can render and test Composition Functions offline, which supports review before rollout, and packages can be built, updated and pushed as versioned artifacts. However, rollback is only implied by the revision mechanism, and versioning and review depend on external git/GitOps tooling rather than a built-in workflow. Missing for 10: explicit documented rollback to a prior revision, a native review/approval workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration of revision-based rollback.
